headline: Fronts Shift as Bases Trade Hands Across Theatre
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the most contested corridors have deepened their exchange of fire. Nevish Line now records 47 ownership changes in the past day, with both Colonial and Warden casualties climbing past 6,200 and 6,800 respectively, and short‑term casualty rates still accelerating. Palantine Berm remains a hotspot with 36 flips, though its one‑hour casualty trend has begun to cool while enlistments rise. Callahans Passage holds steady at 29 flips, each side suffering roughly 11,000 dead in the last 24 hours. Weathered Expanse shows 21 exchanges, a modest drop from the prior count, yet combined losses exceed 13,000 and Warden casualty rates are accelerating. Kuura Strand, after a sharp two‑hour spike, has settled to 21 events with casualty rates now cooling. Stlican Shelf adds 11 flips, its casualty growth modest but persistent. Marban Hollow and Mooring County each report a handful of recent captures, the former with the latest event logged at the current cutoff. The remainder of the map stays largely static, most regions wholly held by a single faction with only low‑level attrition and no ownership activity reported.
